parsed.rationale: All 16 members are empty-field `type-alias-object` declarations (shared_field_count=1, differing_slots=null), each with a distinct name and distinct semantic purpose — `ConfettiView` in PartyHorn, `DebugHUD` in DebugPanel vs. Wallpaper, `WXYCLogo` in WXUI, `DialADJPage`/`HeightReader`/`TalksetView` in app:WatchXYC, etc. The structural signal is purely that they are all zero-body type aliases; there is no shared domain concept, no shared aliased target, and no shared package. Several live under `Examples/` or `SampleApp/` paths (e.g., `Shared/WXUI/Examples/WXUISampleApp/Sources/`, `Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/`) and others are private SwiftUI preview/helper aliases scoped to individual files. Extracting them to a common location would be meaningless and would couple unrelated packages. The coincidence is purely structural.
